'''William B. Gragg''' (2 November 1936 – 25 December 2016) ended his career as an emeritus professor in the Department of Applied Mathematics at the [[Naval Postgraduate School]]. He has made fundamental contributions in [[numerical analysis]], particularly the areas of [[numerical linear algebra]] and [[numerical methods for ordinary differential equations]].

He received his PhD at [[UCLA]] in 1964 under the direction of [[Peter Henrici (mathematician)|Peter Henrici]]. His dissertation work resulted in the [[Bulirsch–Stoer algorithm|Gragg Extrapolation]] method<ref>http://epubs.siam.org/doi/pdf/10.1137/0702030 On extrapolation algorithms for ordinary initial value problems, WB Gragg SINUM, vol. 2, no. 3, 1965.</ref> for the numerical solution of [[ordinary differential equations]] (sometimes also called the [[Bulirsch–Stoer algorithm]]).

Gragg is also well known for his work on the [[QR algorithm]] for [[unitary matrix|unitary]] [[Hessenberg matrix|Hessenberg matrices]], on updating the [[QR factorization]],<ref>{{cite journal | last1 = Daniel | first1 = J. W. | last2 = Gragg | first2 = W. B. | last3 = Kaufman | first3 = L. | last4 = Stewart | first4 = G. W. | year = 1976 | title = Reorthogonalization and stable algorithms for updating the Gram-Schmidt factorization | journal = Math. Comp. | volume = 30 | issue = 136| pages = 772–795 | doi=10.1090/S0025-5718-1976-0431641-8| doi-access = free }}</ref>
superfast solution of [[Toeplitz matrix|Toeplitz systems]],<ref>{{cite journal | doi = 10.1137/0609005 | volume=9 | title=Superfast Solution of Real Positive Definite Toeplitz Systems | journal=SIAM Journal on Matrix Analysis and Applications | pages=61–76| hdl=10945/30445 | year=1988 | last1=Ammar | first1=Gregory S. | last2=Gragg | first2=William B. | citeseerx=10.1.1.64.8032 }}</ref> parallel algorithms for solving eigenvalue problems,<ref>[https://web.archive.org/web/20141103182712/http://oai.dtic.mil/oai/oai?verb=getRecord&metadataPrefix=html&identifier=ADA262297 Article title] A Parallel Divide and Conquer Algorithm for the Generalized Real Symmetric Definite Tridiagonal Eigenproblem, C.F. Borges and W.B.Gragg, 1992</ref><ref>{{cite journal | doi=10.1007/BF01386438 | volume=57 | title=A divide and conquer method for unitary and orthogonal eigenproblems | journal=Numerische Mathematik | pages=695–718|year = 1990|last1 = Gragg|first1 = W. B.| last2=Reichel | first2=L. | hdl=10945/29823 | s2cid=53684596 | hdl-access=free }}</ref> as well as his exposition on the [[Pade table]] and its relation to a large number of algorithms in [[numerical analysis]].<ref>{{cite journal | doi = 10.1137/1014001 | volume=14 | title=The Padé Table and Its Relation to Certain Algorithms of Numerical Analysis | journal=SIAM Review | pages=1–62| year=1972 | last1=Gragg | first1=W. B. | doi-access=free }}
</ref>
